tax: Impozitul pe venit: creșterea de capital (gains of individuals on disposals)
statute: Codul fiscal art. 37-41 (art. 40 alin. (1), (5¹), (6), (7), art. 41 alin. (1)), art. 15 lit. a) (12 %)
dated: Codul fiscal nr. 1163/1997 as in force 01.01.2025, read on legis.md in a browser on 25-26 November 2026 (doc_id=138612)
unsupported: a personal exemption (art. 33-35) left unused by the person's other income is not set against the gain
every asset of kind vehicle is taken as a car, collection vehicles (art. 40 (5¹)) are not distinguished
gifts treated as sales by the donor (art. 40 (4), (5)) are not in the input
